Bodhi Tree is a beautiful property with a very warm and welcoming team. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the overall property was spotless.

One of the highlights of our stay was the view from our room—we could see the Stupa as well as the majestic Khardung La peak, which made the experience even more special.

We stayed at Bodhi Tree for 5 nights total during our trip — 3 nights at the start and 2 at the end.

We had booked the Premium Room for 4 people (2 adults + 2 kids aged 11 and 14). The room had one king-size bed and a lounge area with sofas, and at check-in we were told the sofa bed would be used for the 4th person. It technically accommodates 4, but it’s not very comfortable for a family of four, especially with older kids.

Breakfast was included during the first 3 nights. Apart from the made-to-order items like eggs, pancakes, breads, etc., the buffet quality was disappointing — much of the food felt cold or stale. I’d rate the breakfast around 2/5. The à la carte food was good, though expensive; we spent around ₹9k over those 3 days.

During the last 2 nights, I had accidentally not selected the breakfast package. On the first morning, after we had already started taking food from the buffet, the restaurant manager repeatedly pointed out that breakfast was not included. I immediately said we would pay, but the discussion kept going and became awkward. The same thing happened the next morning as well, with staff again reminding us multiple times that “extra charge lagega.”

The hotel itself is nice, but the staff interactions did not feel premium. Situations like this could be handled more gracefully and discreetly.

Dear Neerav, Thank you for taking the time to share such thoughtful, detailed feedback after your 5 nights with us. We are truly sorry that the breakfast buffet and the way our restaurant team handled the package conversation took away from what should have felt seamless and warm — that simply isn't the Bodhi Tree experience we wish for you. Your notes on the Premium Room layout and breakfast quality have already been shared with our F&B and front office teams, and we are working to refine both. We would love the chance to host you and your family again, and to show you the gentler, more graceful Bodhi Tree we know we can be. Warm regards, — Team Bodhi Tree
